{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse the revenue column from string to float, handling commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check if the parsing worked
print('Revenue after parsing:', sales_df['revenue'].head())

# Confirm the data is clean
print('\nAfter parsing revenue, data types:\n', sales_df.dtypes)

# Now, filter for loyal customers only
loyal_customers = sales_df[sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the fraction of loyal customers who converted
fraction_converted = loyal_customers['converted'].mean()

# Output the result
fraction_converted"}
